title: Retries with exponential backoff and jitter

videos.script: Payments fails one call in ten. With one attempt, one sale in ten fails too. With three, none of seven hundred did. {{attempts}} Between attempts, the wait doubles. Exponential backoff gives a struggling service room to recover. {{backoff}} But a thousand callers who all wait exactly the same time come back together, again and again. Jitter spreads them out. {{jitter}} Then the dangerous part. A retry after a timeout charged cards twice: thirty four tickets, forty eight charges. {{twice}} An idempotency key names the sale once, and the same run gives forty five tickets and forty five charges. {{keys}} Retries multiply across layers, so one layer retries and the others fail fast. {{amplify}} And when the box office says wait, buyers who listen get thirty one percent more tickets sold. {{polite}}
